scope: bounded synthetic backend mechanics; no embedding model or semantic-quality claim
data_generator: sha256 deterministic coordinates; four clustered centers plus uniform points; lane is row index modulo 3; unique numeric vectors
memory_method: isolated subprocess per backend/size/dimension; resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss converted to bytes; includes native allocations and baseline runtime; no tracemalloc
timing_method: perf_counter; import/open, materialization, ingest, each cold filtered-tree build and warmed query p50/p95 measured separately; worker count 1
decision_rule: Report all cells, misses, ties, timeouts and failures. No performance pass threshold or default winner. ANN recall below 0.95 triggers ITERATE, never query/budget/epsilon tuning. Real-corpus quality remains gated by #158.
